query:
SELECT id, claimed_at AS "claimed_at!"
            FROM attachments
            WHERE claimed_at IS NOT NULL
              AND deleting_at IS NULL
              AND claimed_at < now() - ($1 || ' hours')::interval
              AND ($3::timestamptz IS NULL OR (claimed_at, id) > ($3, $4))
            ORDER BY claimed_at ASC, id ASC
            LIMIT $2
